subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required.’**

I enjoy **__learn__** languages because I like them.
solution:
The correct answer is **"learning."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is grammatically incorrect as it uses **"enjoy"** with the infinitive **"to learn."**
 
• It should be** "enjoy learning."**
 
• In the corrected version,** "learning" **must be used which is the gerund form of the verb** "learn."**
 
• It is the appropriate form to use after the verb **"enjoy."**
 
• The correct answer is option 3.**
 

Correct sentence__:* ****I enjoy __**learning**__ languages because I like them. *
